name: You Monster
description: Scuttle a ship while its pet was still aboard and no other ship could take it.

name: A Full Life
description: A hamster of yours died of old age. It was a month old.

name: The Immortal Hampter
description: Keep one hamster alive for 5 cycles.

name: Speedrun
description: Raise a hamster with a negative life span.

name: This Is a Warship
description: Have a pet on 10 ships of your fleet at once.

name: Priorities
description: A pet took the escape pod when its ship went down. The crew was told to wait for the next one.

name: Who's a Good Captain
description: Win a battle with a ship commanded by its pet.

name: You Had One Job
description: Let a pet starve.

name: Minesweeper
description: Find 25 mines by flying into them.

name: Collect Them All
description: Get hit by a railgun, a mortar and a missile battery.

name: Danger Close
description: Get hit by an artillery strike you called yourself.

name: Dinosaur
description: Get hit by a meteor. It worked on the dinosaurs too.

name: No Drilling Crew Needed
description: Blow up a meteor with a missile.

name: Visibility Zero
description: Get ambushed by a fleet hiding in fog.

name: Safety Third
description: Dismantle a warning beacon. The next captain will find out the old way.

name: World Peace
description: Your Privateer Base ran out of enemies to raid.

name: Feng Shui
description: Move a planet with the Rift Generator. The system looks better this way.

name: It's a Feature
description: Print a hull with heavy print defects.

name: Burnout
description: Work a Variable Production Chip to death in a Commodity Forge.

name: It Belongs in a Museum
description: Put a ship with 5 or more D-mods on display in a Museum. Visitors are asked not to lean on it.

name: Free Shipping
description: Pay a courier more than the cargo is worth.

name: Tourist Trap
description: Build every World Symbol.

name: Identity Crisis
description: Train one officer through all five personalities at the Academy.

name: Flip Flop
description: Repeal an Edict early and pay for it in unrest.

name: Diplomatic Baggage
description: Sell or jettison an ambassador you were supposed to deliver.

name: Refund Policy
description: The Automated Shipyard handed back the same hull you fed it.

name: Might Need It Later
description: Sit on 2,000 Relic Components.

name: For Ludd's Sake
description: Open the ? help in 10 different panels. Somebody does read them.

name: Delegation
description: Lose a whole detachment while you were somewhere else.
